setting_and_country.value: Clinical psychology programme, Florida State University, United States
setting_and_country.quote: Our writing retreat has occurred at a cost-responsible location approximately 90 miles west of Florida State University.

design.value: Model description with preliminary outcome data (post-retreat self-report, no pre-test)
design.quote: We decided to collect outcome data following the retreat

participants.value: 2015 pilot: 7 graduate students; 2016: 14 trainees and 2 faculty members
participants.quote: across the 14 trainees and two faculty members in attendance, 24 scientific manuscripts were written, in whole or in part, during this second retreat

group_format.value: Annual lab-wide residential writing retreat over four nights: intensive writing during the day with a fixed stop time, facilitator-led evening group discussion of progress and roadblocks, recreational group activities
group_format.quote: After the daily writing period, we come together as a group to discuss what was achieved during the day, roadblocks, and action plans for moving forward.

comparison.quote: We also endeavor to prospectively examine productivity at points in time that do not coincide with the structured writing retreat as a pseudocontrol group.

other_writing_outcomes.value: 2015: 11 manuscripts from 7 graduate students; 2016: 24 manuscripts, 1 grant proposal, 4 new project ideas, dissertation and thesis prospectus progress; student-only follow-up retreats faded after about 3 months
other_writing_outcomes.quote: among seven graduate student participants, 11 scientific manuscripts were directly attributable to the time spent writing during the retreat

notes: Facilitated by the lab director (a professor), so not purely peer-led; outcomes are counts of self-reported products, not measured confidence.
